tips.title: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line
tips.body: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter always sends. On a phone, Enter is a new line.

tips.title: Plan before anything changes
tips.body: Turn on Plan under the composer, or press Shift+Tab, and the agent reads and plans without editing. It stays on for that session.

mediaBrief.shot: Composer bottom bar with Plan switched on, the agent's reply a plan checklist above it.

tips.title: Attach PDFs, spreadsheets and documents
tips.body: The paperclip, a paste or a drag takes up to 8 files a message, 25 MB each. Big photos are shrunk for you.

mediaBrief.shot: A PDF dragged onto the composer; its chip appears; one more pasted; send.

tips.title: Type / for commands and skills
tips.body: / in the composer lists every command and skill the agent knows, filtered as you type.

media.alt: Typing a slash in the composer opens a menu of commands and skills that narrows as you type.

tips.title: Tab takes the suggested reply
tips.body: After the first turn, a guess at your next message shows in the empty composer. Tab or → takes it; typing sets it aside.

mediaBrief.shot: Empty composer shows a grey suggested reply; Tab fills it in.

tips.title: Choose what the agent may do
tips.body: The access picker under the composer has Ask first, Accept edits and Full access. Ask first shows an approval card for anything not already allowed.

mediaBrief.shot: The access picker open, showing Ask first, Accept edits, Full access.

tips.title: Undo a message and its edits
tips.body: Undo on a message puts back the files the agent edited since and returns the message to the composer. Shell command changes aren't tracked.

mediaBrief.shot: A user message with its Undo action visible on hover.

tips.title: Hand a chat to the terminal
tips.body: The Chat / Terminal switch in the tab bar resumes the same conversation in the agent's own terminal, and back.

mediaBrief.shot: Click Terminal in the Chat / Terminal switch; the same conversation resumes in the terminal.

tips.title: Star a message to find it later
tips.body: Star a message, a step or a whole turn. The star in the chat header lists them and jumps to one.

mediaBrief.shot: Chat header's star list open with three bookmarks.

tips.title: ⌘K searches every conversation
tips.body: Type in ⌘K for matching chats, or Tab for a full search of what you and the agents said.

mediaBrief.shot: ⌘K, type two words, matching chats appear, Tab switches to the full search.

tips.title: ⌥N opens a draft
tips.body: A draft in the project you're in. Nothing starts until you send, and unsent drafts wait under Drafts.

mediaBrief.shot: ⌥N opens a draft with project, agent and worktree chips; type a line.

tips.title: Make a session a task
tips.body: Tick Open a PR when done on a draft and it runs in its own worktree and ends in a pull request.

tips.title: Pin a session
tips.body: Pin in a row's ⋯ menu keeps it on the Pinned shelf, and a pinned session never settles on its own.

tips.title: Snooze until tomorrow
tips.body: Snooze in a row's ⋯ menu hides it until 9 AM tomorrow or next Monday. It wakes early if it needs you.

mediaBrief.shot: A row's ⋯ menu open on Snooze with Tomorrow and Next week.

tips.title: Put sessions in a group
tips.body: Move to group → New group… in a row's ⋯ menu gives them their own shelf. Select moves many at once.

mediaBrief.shot: Sidebar with a named group shelf holding three sessions.

tips.title: The dot that shows machine load
tips.body: The dot in the sidebar header turns amber or red when the machine is busy. Tap it to see which sessions use the most CPU.

mediaBrief.shot: The machine load popover: the dot amber, the top CPU sessions listed.

tips.title: Sign off and merge from the app
tips.body: Sign off & merge merges a task's PR once CI is green, then removes its worktree and branches.

mediaBrief.shot: A task in review with CI green and the Sign off & merge button.

tips.title: Cap how many tasks run at once
tips.body: Settings → Workspaces sets a running limit. Extra tasks wait under Queued and start in order.

tips.title: Pause a task for a while
tips.body: A running task's row menu pauses it for an hour, until tomorrow, or until you resume it.

tips.title: Approve a plan piece by piece
tips.body: A plan waiting on you lists its pieces, each with Merge into ① or Drop, and Approve with note… for the whole plan.

mediaBrief.shot: A plan awaiting approval with two pieces, Merge into ① and Drop on the second.

tips.title: Run tasks on another machine
tips.body: Link a second machine and queued tasks start there when this one is busy. Linking more than one machine with Connect needs Pro.

tips.title: Run a board as a stack
tips.body: In a project linked to a board, Run as stack starts the cards as stacked PRs, and Land merges them in order.

mediaBrief.shot: A stack of three tasks with their PR states and Land.

tips.title: Start work on a timer
tips.body: Schedules in the sidebar's ⋯ menu runs a prompt every day, every few hours, or once.

mediaBrief.shot: The Schedules form filled in: daily at 9 AM, a prompt, a project.

tips.title: Check in on a long session
tips.body: Schedule check-ins in a session's ⋯ menu sends it a message on a timer.

tips.title: Save a job you'll do again
tips.body: Save as recipe on a finished session or task fills in a recipe from what it did. Each run starts fresh.

mediaBrief.shot: The recipe form prefilled from a finished session.

tips.title: Sessions can talk to each other
tips.body: Agents run aos peers to see other sessions and aos send to message one.

tips.title: Wait for a reply without polling
tips.body: aos send <session> --await ends the agent's turn and wakes it with the answer.

tips.title: Read what your agents say to each other
tips.body: Messages shows every conversation between sessions, and you can join any of them.

mediaBrief.shot: Messages with two sessions talking, one waiting on a reply.

tips.title: Use AgentOS from your phone
tips.body: Settings → Devices & access → Add a device shows a code to scan. Each code works once.

tips.title: Reach this machine from anywhere
tips.body: Connect gives it a private address that works off your home network, free for one machine.

tips.title: Get pushes when an agent needs you
tips.body: Settings → Notifications → Your phone sends a test push to check it works.

tips.title: Shares are masked before upload
tips.body: The Share dialog shows exactly what goes up, with secrets, addresses and emails masked. Nothing leaves until Create link.

mediaBrief.shot: The Share dialog preview with masked values highlighted, before Create link.

tips.title: Links can expire
tips.body: Create link lasts 1, 7 or 30 days, or never. Revoke one in Settings → Shared links.

tips.title: Hand a chat to another AI
tips.body: Export for AI… in the ⋯ menu saves the chat as Markdown, JSON or HTML, with secrets masked.

mediaBrief.shot: The Export for AI sheet: format, Compact selected, the size estimate.

tips.title: Compact export for long chats
tips.body: Compact drops thinking and trims tool output, and the sheet warns when a file is too big for most models.

tips.title: Update without interrupting work
tips.body: Update when idle in the update banner waits until nothing is working.

tips.title: See what changed in each update
tips.body: The sparkle next to the lightbulb lists every change. A dot on it means something new since you last looked.
